leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Construct a generic ValueOf type that extracts union types from object property values.
Apply the ValueOf type to transform a given object type into a union of its value types.
Manipulate the ValueOf type to handle nested object structures by extracting values recursively.
Integrate the ValueOf type with existing TypeScript types to enhance type safety in functions.
Initialize a TypeScript project and configure tsconfig.json to support advanced type utilities like ValueOf.
Implement a function that uses the ValueOf type to constrain parameter values to valid object property values.
Render type errors and successes in an IDE to validate the correctness of the ValueOf type implementation.
